items.title: Recife (PE) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 11 #4046
items.en_title: Recife (PE) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 11 #4046
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Recife (PE) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 201,140,200; proposals close Dec 11 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
